newsitem.title: CHINA: China Aug mth/mth interbank rates generally lower.
newsitem.headline: China Aug mth/mth interbank rates generally lower.

text.p: China interbank market rates generally fell in active trading in August as a result of the interest rate cut by the central bank on August 23, the Shanghai Securities Newspaper said on Tuesday.
The 120-day rate was the biggest loser month on month, falling 0.23 percentage points, followed by the 90-day rate which fell 0.207 percentage points.
Combined volume on the interbank market rose 3.07 percent to 54.278 billion yuan on August, with 19.855 billion yuan traded in the primary market and 34.423 billion in the secondery market.
The most-active 60-day rate recorded a volume of 13.982 billion yuan or 25.76 percent of total volume. This was followed by the 7-day rate with 13.521 billion yuan or 24.91 percent of total volume.
Trading of 20-day, 120-day and one-day rates rose 47.87, 24.71 and 17.09 percent, respectively. The remaining four rates posted smaller volumes than in July.
